data.name: The Vilbil: Online Hub for Art and Artists
data.detailed_description:
The Vilbil: Online Hub for Art and Artists is a virtual reality showroom built to bring together contemporary artists from around the world. It’s a welcoming space where distance doesn’t matter—just the art, the space it occupies, and the people who experience it. Step inside, and you’ll discover a vibrant collection of creativity from every continent, all in one place. Explore unique styles and discover global voices in ways you simply can’t in a traditional gallery.

In our virtual exhibition halls, modern art comes alive with 100% accurate replication of every piece. VR lets you go beyond the limits of physical buildings. Take your time to study the fine details, enjoy the vibrant colors, and see how each artwork interacts with the environment around it. Whether you're an art collector or just curious, you can explore at your own pace, experiencing the art exactly as the creator intended in its true 1:1 scale—allowing you to visualize how these masterpieces would look on a real-world wall.

As you move through The Vilbil, you’ll wander a variety of beautiful, thoughtfully designed spaces—from calm, minimalist halls to dreamlike, imaginative architecture. Each room is created to highlight the art, offering a peaceful and contemplative atmosphere. There are no crowds and no noise—just you and the creative visions of today’s artists, with the unique opportunity to inquire about your favorite pieces and bring them from the virtual showroom into your life.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR, requires motion controllers
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad Core 4 Ghz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 4070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR, requires motion controllers

content_descriptors.notes: The application is an online virtual hub and digital art gallery. It contains contemporary and classic paintings and digital art that include artistic nudity. There is no explicit sexual violence or non-consensual sexual content.
